THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT Heard on admission.
2. Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that the petition is not bad for necessary of non joinder of parties.
One Mallanna Biradar is not arrayed as party.
On this ground sought for allow this appeal.

3. A perusal of para 20 of the impugned judgment, the tribunal has observed as under:
"20.
And in support of these case they have also produced Ex P-1 to P-25
It is very pertinent to note that, the Ex P-1 is the FIR.

wherein it has been specifically stated,
the Bus bearing NO- KA-28-F-856 was driven by its deriver in a very rash and negligent, and the said bus was fell on the quarry of the Mallanna Biradar
And it is also specifically stated that, the 2nd accused in the Criminal case is not fixed the boundaries, and thereby the accident has been accrued.

Ex.P-2 specifically states that, the sustaining of injury in the accident And in the complaint it is specifically stated that who himself is complainant has specifically stated that he himself and 32 other persons have involved in the accident And Ex.P-4 which is MV report clearly establishes the sustaining of damages of the vehicle, and wound certificates Ex.P-5.&
8 to 19, and 19A, will certainly establishes that the injured were treated by the Doctor that on 9-8-2007 with a history of toad traffic accident, and they brought by Talikoti police.
The learned counsel appearing for the respondent has specifically cross examined the witnesses, it is specifically suggested that, the Bus was fell on the quarry.
and it is also admitted that, the Bus was fell down in side the quarry.
And it is also specifically stated that, there is no board or a supporting wall for the quarry.
But it will suggested that.
the accident was accrued that the on account of the negligent Act of the quarry owner, and hence the respondent is not liable to pay the any compensation.

But that fact has been specifically denied, and it is also specifically suggested that there was no rash and negligent driving of the respondent driver, but that is not fully established before the Court.

It is also very pertinent to note that,

sentences.text: though, respondent has took up a contention that respondent has not driven the vehicle in a very rash and negligent manner.
To substantiate that aspect no material is placed on record.
On the other hand it is an admitted fact by the petitioner, that the respondent vehicle fell in the quarry which is situated by the side of the road.
If really there was no rash and negligent driving of the respondent driver, the sustaining of such accident would not have been arise at all.
And it is also very pertinent to note that, in this case the quarry owner has not been made as a party.

And it is also very pertinent to note that, the petition has been filed only against the KSRTC And the injuries certificates, and postmortem report will certainly establishes the sustaining of injury by the petitioners in the accident.

Under such circumstances, when all the witnesses have specifically stated about the aspect of the accident, and establishes the sustaining of injury by wound certificate, and caused of death of the person by postmortem report which is marked as Ex P-17 says that postmortern was conducted on 9-8-2007, and death was due to the hemorrhage shock, as a result of injury sustained, and he succumbed to death on the same day as on the date of accident.
Such being the case.

I am of the opinion that, the direct nexus between accident and death of that person has been established Hence, I have no hesitation to answer the issue NO-1, in Affirmative in all the cases."
4.
A perusal of this impugned judgment, I do not find any legal ground to interfere with the impugned judgment and award passed by the tribunal.
5. The appellant has also filed IA No.5 of Limitation Act for condonation of delay of 1214 days in filing the appeal.

This application is submitted with an affidavit of Savita Shetty W/o R.S.Hullur, in which she has not explained the delay in filing the appeal as there is an abnormal delay in filing the in filing the appeal.

Hence, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER (1) Appeal is not admitted and the same is dismissed.
( 2) The application filed under Section 5 of Limitation Act is also dismissed.
(3) Registry is directed to transfer the deposited amount to Tribunal.

Sd/-
